messages:
alice_ops: Heads up — south-region node joins failing after this morning's firewall rollout. Keystore connections timing out, warm pools stuck at 0. Sample log: `dial tcp 10.20.3.5:443: i/o timeout`
ben_platform: Copy. Is that the deny-by-default L7 rule from 03:12? @carla_security did a sweep earlier right?
carla_security: Yup, that was me. Tightening audit exporters across regions. I accidentally omitted the keystore service tag from the allowlist. Rolling a quick revert now.
dave_sre: Revert is good short-term. If we need a fast mitigation, open outbound to keystore CIDR 10.20.3.0/24 + 10.20.4.12 and force warmpool restart: `kubectl -n infra rollout restart daemonset/warmpool`
alice_ops: I can add the CIDR exception. Tagging deploy-bot to apply change.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Applying firewall change — add egress allow 10.20.3.0/24:443. Change ID: FW-6421.
ben_platform: Monitor keystore auth logs for decrypt failures while the exception is present. This will bump audit/exporter traffic though — cost heads-up. Carla, can we instead allow by service principal/tag rather than net-range?
carla_security: Good point. I'll reapply the rule scoped to the keystore service-tag and then remove the net-range exception. ETA ~7m.
dave_sre: Nodes are retrying. Warmpool logs show intermittent `keystore: auth success` entries now. Control-plane CPU spiked while backlog drains.
alice_ops: Watching queue depth. If queue gets >500 we'll trigger temporary scaling which costs more. Prefer let warmup drain if possible. Any objections to keeping exception open for 30m?
ben_platform: :thumbsup: sounds fine. Carla please post when you flip to service-tag allow so we can remove the net exception.
carla_security: Flipped to service-tag allow (keystore:prod). Reapplying tightened rule now, then removing net allow. Change ID: FW-6422.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Removing firewall exception FW-6421. Audit ref: 0xafe123.
dave_sre: Confirmed joins healthy again, warm pool targets at 80% within 6m. No more keystore timeouts in logs.
alice_ops: Thanks all. Action items: postmortem on why keystore tag missing from allowlist + add preflight test to validate keystore egress for future rule rollouts. I'll open a ticket and tag eng-platform.
carla_security: Will create the ticket and include rough cost calc for the ~30m warmpool bump (~$420).
